svg.title: Tool-definition tokens: direct MCP vs Mycel at 8, 9 and 15 servers
svg.desc: Horizontal bars. 8 servers: 17.8k vs 1.0k. 9 servers with Canva: 44.5k vs 1.05k. 15 servers, 414 tools: about 204k vs 1.2k, which exceeds a 200k context window. The 414-tool figure is tool-definition tokens (~4 chars per token) measured in a local lab; not yet reproducible from the repo.
